title: NTP Sync Flow
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Clocks and Watches with AI
description: A Mermaid flowchart of a Pico W time sync with clickable steps that show their MicroPython code and toggles that light up the WiFi and NTP retry paths.

learningObjectives: Sequence the steps of an NTP time sync
Identify what the program should do at each failure point

keyQuestions: What should the clock do if WiFi fails?
Why convert to local time only after the sync?
commonMisconceptions: A failed sync should stop the program
assessmentOpportunities: Name the exception raised by a failed NTP request and how to handle it

controls: Click or hover a node to see its code
